content:
incident-bot: [PROD ALERT] High 5xx error rate detected on gateway-route /v1/generate — 12m window, error_rate=7.4% (threshold 5%). Pager: eng-oncall.

alice: seeing the same in Grafana > realtime. spikes started ~10:02 UTC. not from a deploy AFAICT. :thinking_face:

carla: I pushed the routing tweak to route-optimizer yesterday — reverting to stable now. rolling back canary to version v2.1.3 -> v2.1.1.

k8s-monitor: ReplicaSet route-optimizer-canary scaled from 5 -> 1 (by carla) at 10:08:32 UTC. pod restarts: 0. CPU spike cleared on canary.

ben: oncall here, picking up. thanks for rollback context @carla. can you confirm error rate trending down?

carla: error_rate down to 4.9% over 5m now. latency still slightly elevated.

alice: confirming — looks like backend upstream timeout (upstream-a) was returning 502s during the canary period. support note: upstream provider reported GC pause 10:01-10:10.

dave: customer impact check: Zendesk shows 2 accounts (acct-2312, acct-9987) opened errors around 10:05. both via us-east-1. severity: degraded but not complete outage. filing incident tag INC-1234.

erin: recommend: mute the 5xx pager for 30m while we validate rollback and let autoscaling settle. then create a short-term suppression rule for upstream flaps instead of raw 5xx percent.

ben: agree. I'll silence the alert in Alertmanager for 30m and create a follow-up ticket to tune the rule. doing silence now: `curl -XPOST $ALERTMGR/api/v2/silences -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"GatewayHigh5xx"}],"startsAt":"2026-03-17T10:12:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-17T10:42:00Z","createdBy":"ben","comment":"temporary mute during rollback"}'`

carla: thanks. also adding a short-term fallback route so that requests hit replica-b when upstream-a reports >20% errors. pushed config to service-mesh: `fallback_rule: upstream-a -> replica-b if error_rate>0.2 for 2m`

alice: can we also loosen the alert evaluation window and require sustained errors from >=2 backends? current rule is too noisy: 5% over 5m on any route triggers pager. suggestion: change to 5% over 10m AND total 5xx count > 100.

ben: sounds reasonable. I'll propose exact PromQL and make a PR:
```
expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[10m]))
      / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway"}[10m]))) * 100 > 5
and
sum(increase(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[10m])) > 100
```
Will attach to PR for alert-rules repo.

dave: also request a temporary dashboard showing per-upstream 5xx heatmap + support ticket links. useful for post-incident notes.

erin: I can carve out a Grafana panel: /dashboards/ops/gateway/post-incident-views . adding panel for per-region, per-upstream, customer error counts. ETA 2h.

carla: runbook note: add step to check upstream provider status page and escalate to partnerships if providers report maintenance. current runbook only addresses internal deploys.

ben: handoff: I'm oncall for next 4h. leaving silence until 10:42 UTC. monitoring for reappearance. if 5xx >6% for 10m reopen pager.

incident-bot: Pager closed by ben at 10:12:40 UTC — condition cleared below threshold.

ben: creating follow-up tasks: INC-1234-1 (tune alert rule & add suppression logic), INC-1234-2 (dashboard panel), INC-1234-3 (runbook update). assigning owners: erin, erin, carla respectively.

alice: one more ask: consider adding an alert that detects sudden correlation between deploys and 5xx (deploy -> spike within 5m) so we can auto-flag canary issues. I'll draft an idea.

ben: good idea. closing thread for now but will post PR links and the follow-up ticket numbers when created. :thumbsup:
